_description: Shrink-only size budgets for AUTO-LOADED agent guides still over the 40,000-char cap. A listed guide may be at most its recorded size, and must be re-recorded when it shrinks; a guide not listed must be at most 40,000. `pnpm claude-md:update` lowers entries and removes ones for guides now under the cap or gone, and never raises or adds one — an increase is a hand edit in a reviewable diff. See the header of scripts/check-claude-md.mjs.
